Name: Portraits for Kacchan
Author: Blossom5280
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8]Want some portraits with the Katsuki Bakugou mod? feeling for a more chibi flavor?[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Welcome to my mod :3[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]I've hand drawn the artwork which i've been heavily inspired by nyapu's lovely portraits!

These portraits are made by myself :3
[/center]
[center][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Important Note:[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Whether you want seasonal attire or just want the single outfit? i highly recommend downloading bezajel's mod too as her mod also adds dialogue![/b][/size][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8][u]Seasonal instructions:[/u]

1. Install my mod and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46336]bezajel's mod[/url] 

2. Install emkabonbonka's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46075]Katsuki Bakugou Mod[/url] along with any requirements

3. Set up the config to match bezajel's mod too! it will not work correctly as my portraits replaces hers! [/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8]4. Profit :3[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8]Non Seasonal Instructions:[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8]1. Install my mod [/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8]2. Install emkabonbonka's Katsuki Bakugou Mod[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8]3. Profit[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8]Hand drawn portraits to reflect seasons and 1 festival outfit!

i highly reccomend to download bezajel's mod too as hers also includes extra dialogue and seasonal toggles!

if ya simply want the base portraits then downloading mine or bezajel's is cool![/color][/center]
